Watermark computation and reserve sizing beyond minimum reserve use.

findings.text: Slow path allocation interface accepts caller flags and order and context and returns a page or null after exhausting wakeup and reserve and reclamation and compaction and killer stages, serving as the fallback behind the fast path.

Slow path moves among fresh start and repeated attempt and failure and success outcomes, with an early compaction bias for expensive or non-movable requests, then reclamation followed by compaction, guarded by policy change restarts and by separate gates for reclaim feasibility and compaction suitability and fragment avoidance fallback and killer progress.

Direct reclaim throttling allows progress when hopeless or when no reserve exists, otherwise totals minimum reserves and free memory across managed zones up to ZONE_NORMAL while skipping zones with only unreclaimable free pages, permitting reclaim only when free exceeds half the reserve and otherwise ensuring wakeup through kswapd_wait with kswapd_highest_zoneidx clamped.

Direct reclaim widens target order using pageblock_order for ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT requests with non MIGRATE_MOVABLE class, accounts stall, performs one reclamation, retries free list, and on first miss releases high atomic reserves and drains per processor caches before final retry.
Background wakeup chooses reclaim order using pageblock_order when defrag_mode is set, then visits each eligible managed zone once per node and requests wakeup with highest_zoneidx as ceiling.
Nonblocking derivation returns no latitude for __GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM or __GFP_NOMEMALLOC, otherwise applies ALLOC_NON_BLOCK and adds ALLOC_HIGHATOMIC only for higher order with __GFP_HIGH.

Slow path composition starts from ALLOC_WMARK_MIN and ALLOC_CPUSET, then adds ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE for __GFP_HIGH and ALLOC_KSWAPD for __GFP_KSWAPD_RECLAIM plus nonblocking and contiguous and ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT handling, while dropping ALLOC_CPUSET for atomic elevated requests without __GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM and adding reserve access for realtime tasks.

Deferred draining serializes each rcu_free_pcpu queue with its interrupt disabling spinlock while moving pending entries to a local batch and clearing nr_pending, then waits for expedited grace before freeing outside locks.

Deferred waiting declines for victim or signaled callers and after MAX_RECLAIM_RETRIES or beyond PAGE_ALLOC_COSTLY_ORDER, otherwise scans eligible zones and when reclaimable plus NR_FREE_PAGES plus NR_FREE_RCU_PAGES could satisfy minimum watermark it drains once and requests retry.

Retry accounting resets counters only on useful progress for orders within PAGE_ALLOC_COSTLY_ORDER and otherwise advances no progress count with MAX_RECLAIM_RETRIES ceiling, then tests whether reclaimable plus NR_FREE_PAGES could satisfy any eligible zone, pauses briefly for PF_WQ_WORKER or yields otherwise, and finally falls back to deferred drain and high atomic exhaustion before reporting failure.
Retry clears nodemask when it no longer intersects allowed memory and otherwise requests restart only when allowed memory changed during the attempt.

Warning stays silent for stalls below ALLOC_STALL_WARN_MSECS and for __GFP_NOWARN and until alloc_stall_warn_jiffies expires, then under best effort lock refreshes next allowed time and emits diagnostics with process and timing and order and mode and node restriction and allowed memory and stack and memory overview.

Preparation derives highest_zoneidx and zonelist and migratetype from caller flags, applies __GFP_HARDWALL and current allowed memory with ALLOC_CPUSET handling, enforces failure injection unless ALLOC_NOLOCK, records contiguous needs and __GFP_WRITE dirtiness, and selects preferred_zoneref.

Allocation context carries highest_zoneidx and zonelist and nodemask and migratetype and alloc_flags and preferred_zoneref and spread_dirty_pages, with preferred entry recomputed whenever policy is ignored or iteration restarts.
Node state exposes kswapd_wait and kswapd_highest_zoneidx, while zone accounting uses NR_FREE_PAGES and NR_FREE_RCU_PAGES plus reclaimable counts and minimum reserve in watermark checks.
Stall warning uses alloc_stall_lock acquired only opportunistically, rechecking deadline both before and inside the critical section and updating next allowed time.

Guards refuse direct reclamation under PF_MEMALLOC, reject __GFP_NOFAIL without __GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM, avoid endless loops for victims using ALLOC_OOM or __GFP_NOMEMALLOC, validate insane layouts for __GFP_HARDWALL, and degrade ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT when reclamation is unavailable but __GFP_KSWAPD_RECLAIM is set.
Callers flagged PF_WQ_WORKER sleep briefly instead of merely yielding, preventing false idle appearance under concurrency control, while others yield cooperatively.

Control flags observed include ALLOC_WMARK_MIN and ALLOC_CPUSET and ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE and ALLOC_KSWAPD and ALLOC_NON_BLOCK and ALLOC_HIGHATOMIC and ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT and ALLOC_OOM and ALLOC_NOLOCK and ALLOC_NO_WATERMARKS with ALLOC_WMARK_MASK naming, plus contiguous handling.

Caller request flags observed include __GFP_DIRECT_RECLAIM and __GFP_KSWAPD_RECLAIM and __GFP_HIGH and __GFP_NOMEMALLOC and __GFP_HARDWALL and __GFP_NOWARN and __GFP_NORETRY and __GFP_RETRY_MAYFAIL and __GFP_NOFAIL and __GFP_THISNODE and __GFP_WRITE, with zone and mobility and order names ZONE_NORMAL and MIGRATE_MOVABLE and pageblock_order and PAGE_ALLOC_COSTLY_ORDER and MAX_RECLAIM_RETRIES and ALLOC_STALL_WARN_MSECS and compaction priorities and outcomes and PF_MEMALLOC and PF_WQ_WORKER and NR_FREE_PAGES and NR_FREE_RCU_PAGES and MSEC_PER_SEC.
